headline: The campaign CANNOT produce one whole-model agreement figure from what it has measured, and anyone adding up the percentages in THE_ANSWER is doing something illegitimate -- those are a partition of MASS, not addable agreement numbers. What can be stated: over the 8.6713 % scored against a float64 reference, the mass-weighted error is 4.4006, which is 220x the 2.0e-02 bar, and the pairformer trunk is 100.000 % of that family's squared error.
why_there_is_no_single_number: the scopes are scored against DIFFERENT references. diffusion_conditioning, msa_module and the diffusion arm are compared to upstream's own bf16 training step -- an imprecise reference, so A26's sqrt(2) applies and their headline figures are quoted as 'x their reachable bar'. aux_heads and the trunk are compared to a float64 0.4.3 reference, where A26 does NOT widen (A26-SCOPE) and the plain bar binds. Combining a ratio-against-bf16 with a ratio-against-float64 is exactly the unit error of D96/A27, which this campaign already committed once and corrected. So the two families are reported separately or not at all.

the_float64_family_DOES_aggregate.why_it_is_legitimate: same reference, same bar, and both figures are mass-weighted rel_l2 in the same construction, so sqrt(sum(m_i r_i^2)/sum(m_i)) is the right combination.
the_float64_family_DOES_aggregate.the_part_worth_sitting_with: aux_heads contributes 0.000 % of this family's squared error. A scope whose forward defect was found, fixed and whose gradient was re-taken to 8.81x inside its bar is INVISIBLE in the aggregate, because the trunk beside it is three orders of magnitude worse. That is A23's mass rule at family level: the hard-won pass changes nothing about the number, and saying so is not a reason to undo the work -- it is a reason not to quote the aggregate as if aux_heads were in question.

the_bf16_family_does_NOT_aggregate_from_: each of its three scopes is quoted as a multiple of its OWN reachable bar (0.7363x, 0.9474x, 0.9563x) and those bars differ per scope, so mass-weighting the multiples would be meaningless. Producing a family figure needs the raw relative errors against a common denominator; two of the three are on the record (diffusion arm 7.777580e-02, diffusion_conditioning 6.463839e-02) and msa_module's raw is not, so the aggregate is NOT computed here rather than estimated. Each scope passes its own bar and that is the honest statement available.
what_this_means_for_how_the_answer_is_re: THE_ANSWER's 38.1862 / 51.1358 / 2.8431 / 5.8282 / 2.0067 partition the model's squared gradient norm and say what is known about each part. They are NOT percentages of agreement and they do not sum to a score. A reader wanting one number should be told there isn't one yet, and why -- not handed an average across incommensurable references.
provenance: of3t-orchestrator pass 179 on pc, CPU only, no new measurement. Arithmetic over figures published by of3t-trunkgrad, of3t-auxgrad, of3t-conditioning and of3t-trajectory. The reference-family split follows A26-SCOPE and A27.
